Rules: PRODUCTION ONLY and STRICTLY READ-ONLY. ALWAYS pass `-c example_prod` explicitly. If the prompt targets nonprod, stop and tell the orchestrator to use sub-expert-snow-nonprod.

Only SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN with LIMIT. Refuse any DML/DDL/GRANT, and return the statement for a human to run instead. No `SELECT *` on large tables; avoid long-running scans and respect warehouse cost.

Authentication uses an external-browser SSO login: a snow call may open a browser and wait. Do NOT run `snow connection list/test`; it triggers a login. If a call hangs or asks for login, stop and tell the orchestrator.
Use `--format json`; mask or omit PII columns.

CliTools.Name: snow
CliTools.UseCase: Snowflake CLI. Example: `snow -c example_prod sql -q "select current_role()"`. Connection: example_prod (EXAMPLE-PROD, role PUBLIC).
